I recently stayed at this hotel with a wedding group and had a truly wonderful experience. While the property itself is beautiful, it was the exceptional hospitality that made my visit stand out.
Efficient Check-in: A huge thank you to the Reception Manager for the seamless check-in process. Their professional attitude and welcoming nature immediately made me feel at home. It’s rare to see such smooth management right at the entrance.
Outstanding Night Service: I want to give a special shout-out to the Night Manager. Their attention to detail and willingness to assist with my requests during the late hours was incredible. Knowing there is someone so reliable on duty at night made my stay very comfortable.
Overall Experience: The rooms were pristine, the ambiance was relaxing, and the entire staff seemed dedicated to guest satisfaction

​I recently stayed at this hotel, and while the facilities were great, the highlight of my experience was undoubtedly the hospitality provided by the manager, Mr. Jitender.
​What made the stay exceptional:
​Exceptional Leadership: It is rare to find a manager as proactive and dedicated as Jitender. He ensures the entire floor runs like clockwork, and his presence makes you feel like a valued guest rather than just a room number.
​Personalized Attention: Jitender went out of his way to check in on us regularly, ensuring every request was met promptly. His attention to detail is truly impressive.
​Professional & Welcoming: He carries a perfect balance of professionalism and warmth. Whether it was a quick query about the local area or a specific service request, he handled everything with a smile and efficiency.
